title: Orka.ai Groq live SQL evaluation
note: 100 fixed questions. Gold SQL is executed locally to calculate expected results. Categories describe question styles, not isolated model capabilities.

cases.question: How many customers are in the customer database?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers;

cases.question: Count customers whose country is India.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE country = 'India';

cases.question: How many customers live in the United Kingdom?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE country = 'UK';

cases.question: Show every customer name in alphabetical order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_name FROM customers ORDER BY customer_name;

cases.question: List the names of customers located in Germany.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_name FROM customers WHERE country = 'Germany' ORDER BY customer_name;

cases.question: How many customers signed up after March 1, 2025?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE signup_date > DATE '2025-03-01';

cases.question: How many products are listed?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products;

cases.question: List the products in the Electronics category.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY product_name;

cases.question: Which product has the highest price? Return its name and price.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC, product_name LIMIT 1;

cases.question: Find the least expensive product and its price.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price ASC, product_name LIMIT 1;

cases.question: Count all orders with Completed status.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed';

cases.question: How many orders were cancelled?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'Cancelled';

cases.question: Count orders placed during June 2025.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-06-01' AND order_date < DATE '2025-07-01';

cases.question: Show the order IDs and dates for completed orders, oldest first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed' ORDER BY order_date, order_id;

cases.question: How many customers signed up during May 2025?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2025-05-01' AND signup_date < DATE '2025-06-01';

cases.question: Count customers in each country.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY country;

cases.question: Show the number of products in each category.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;

cases.question: What is the average price of all products?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS average_price FROM products;

cases.question: List products costing more than 100, most expensive first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > 100 ORDER BY price DESC, product_name;

cases.question: For every order, show its ID, customer name, and status.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.customer_name, o.status FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_id;

cases.question: How many completed orders were placed by customers from India?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' AND c.country = 'India';

cases.question: Show each customer's name and number of orders, including customers with no orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: Calculate total revenue from all order items using quantity multiplied by product price.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id;

cases.question: Calculate revenue from completed orders only.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed';

cases.question: Calculate revenue from cancelled orders only.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Cancelled';

cases.question: How many units were purchased across all order items, regardless of order status?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS units_sold FROM order_items;

cases.question: How many units were included in completed orders?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS completed_units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed';

cases.question: Show revenue by product name, highest revenue first.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.product_name;

cases.question: Show total revenue for each product category.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category;

cases.question: Count orders by their status.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status;

cases.question: What is the average order value for completed orders? Use completed revenue divided by the number of completed orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS average_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed';

cases.question: Show the total completed-order spend for each customer.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS completed_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY completed_spend DESC, c.customer_name;

cases.question: How many units of each product have been ordered?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS units_ordered FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY p.product_name;

cases.question: Which two products generated the most revenue?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.product_name LIMIT 2;

cases.question: How many distinct customers have placed completed orders?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed';

cases.question: Show completed order counts for each customer country.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_orders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country;

cases.question: Which customer placed the greatest number of orders? Return the customer name and order count.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_name LIMIT 1;

cases.question: What is the earliest order date?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MIN(order_date) AS earliest_order_date FROM orders;

cases.question: What is the most recent order date?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(order_date) AS latest_order_date FROM orders;

cases.question: Count completed orders placed on or after June 10, 2025.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-06-10';

cases.question: What is the average quantity per order-item record?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(quantity) AS average_quantity FROM order_items;

cases.question: For each country, show the number of completed orders and completed revenue.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS completed_orders, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS completed_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country;

cases.question: Which products have never appeared in an order item?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.product_id IS NULL ORDER BY p.product_name;

cases.question: List customer names and countries for customers from India or the UK.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_name, country FROM customers WHERE country IN ('India', 'UK') ORDER BY customer_name;

cases.question: Which products have been ordered at least once? List each product name once.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.product_name FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id ORDER BY p.product_name;

cases.question: Calculate the number of completed orders per month in 2025.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) ORDER BY order_month;

cases.question: Show the total quantity sold for each product category.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category;

cases.question: Find customers who have at least one cancelled order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Cancelled' ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: Calculate the total value of all completed orders for each order ID.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY o.order_id;

cases.question: Show the top three customers by number of completed orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY completed_order_count DESC, c.customer_name LIMIT 3;

cases.question: List all product names and prices from cheapest to most expensive.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price, product_name;

cases.question: How many customers signed up before April 1, 2025?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE signup_date < DATE '2025-04-01';

cases.question: Show all orders placed by customer ID 2.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, status FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 2 ORDER BY order_date, order_id;

cases.question: What is the total number of order item records?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_item_count FROM order_items;

cases.question: Show customers who have not placed any orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: For each order, show its ID and number of item records.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS item_record_count FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_id;

cases.question: Show total quantity ordered for each product, including products never ordered.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY p.product_name;

cases.question: Find total revenue generated by each order, regardless of status.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY o.order_id;

cases.question: Show each customer's order count, including customers with zero orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY order_count DESC, c.customer_name;

cases.question: What is the total quantity in completed orders placed after June 5, 2025?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' AND o.order_date > DATE '2025-06-05';

cases.question: Calculate total sales revenue using the defined revenue metric.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id;

cases.question: Show average order value for all orders as revenue divided by distinct order count.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS average_order_value FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id;

cases.question: Count successful purchases by customer country.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS successful_purchases FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY c.country;

cases.question: Show total items sold by product name.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY p.product_name;

cases.question: Calculate earnings from finished orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS completed_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed';

cases.question: Find average product price within each category.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category, AVG(price) AS average_price FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category;

cases.question: Show the cheapest product in each category with its price.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, category, price FROM (SELECT product_name, category, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price, product_name) AS rn FROM products) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY category;

cases.question: For each customer, show their first order date.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order_date FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: For each customer, show their latest order date.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, MAX(o.order_date) AS latest_order_date FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: Show the number of orders placed on each order date.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_date, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_date ORDER BY order_date;

cases.question: Calculate total units in each order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_units FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_id;

cases.question: Show distinct products included in each order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_products FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY order_id;

cases.question: Find the customer with the highest total spend across all orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY total_spend DESC, c.customer_name LIMIT 1;

cases.question: Show revenue by order status.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.status, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status;

cases.question: For each month, show order count and total units ordered.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) AS order_month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_date) ORDER BY order_month;

cases.question: Show each customer's total units purchased across all orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: Which product category has the highest total revenue?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.category LIMIT 1;

cases.question: List products priced between 30 and 500 inclusive.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price BETWEEN 30 AND 500 ORDER BY price, product_name;

cases.question: Find completed orders placed between June 3 and June 12, 2025 inclusive.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-06-03' AND order_date < DATE '2025-06-13' ORDER BY order_date, order_id;

cases.question: List Indian customers who signed up after April 1, 2025.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_name, country, signup_date FROM customers WHERE country = 'India' AND signup_date > DATE '2025-04-01' ORDER BY customer_name;

cases.question: Find non-cancelled orders placed after June 5, 2025.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date, status FROM orders WHERE status <> 'Cancelled' AND order_date > DATE '2025-06-05' ORDER BY order_date, order_id;

cases.question: Show Electronics or Audio products priced below 500.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, category, price FROM products WHERE category IN ('Electronics', 'Audio') AND price < 500 ORDER BY price, product_name;

cases.question: Find customers with at least two orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) >= 2 ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: Show orders containing more than one unit in total.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_units FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING SUM(quantity) > 1 ORDER BY order_id;

cases.question: List customers who have never placed a cancelled order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'Cancelled') ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: How many orders were placed before June 1, 2025?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date < DATE '2025-06-01';

cases.question: Show products priced above 1000.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > 1000 ORDER BY price DESC, product_name;

cases.question: Show the average price of products in the Furniture category.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(price) AS average_price FROM products WHERE category = 'Furniture';

cases.question: Find customers with no orders.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY c.customer_name;

cases.question: Find maximum and minimum product prices in one result.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(price) AS maximum_price, MIN(price) AS minimum_price FROM products;

cases.question: Show order items where quantity is exactly one.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, product_id, quantity FROM order_items WHERE quantity = 1 ORDER BY order_id, product_id;

cases.question: Count customers whose signup date is in May 2025.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2025-05-01' AND signup_date < DATE '2025-06-01';

cases.question: Show completed orders that have no matching order items, if any.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o.order_id FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed' AND oi.order_id IS NULL ORDER BY o.order_id;

cases.question: Find customers whose names begin with A.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_name FROM customers WHERE customer_name LIKE 'A%' ORDER BY customer_name;

cases.question: Show product count and average price for every category.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count, AVG(price) AS average_price FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY product_count DESC, category;

cases.question: List orders with the earliest order date, including ties.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_date = (SELECT MIN(order_date) FROM orders) ORDER BY order_id;

cases.question: List orders with the latest order date, including ties.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM orders WHERE order_date = (SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM orders) ORDER BY order_id;

cases.question: Count distinct customers with at least one item in a completed order.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'Completed';

cases.question: Show all customers and countries ordered by country and customer name.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_name, country FROM customers ORDER BY country, customer_name;

cases.question: Return the number of products in the category named Garden, including zero if none exist.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products WHERE category = 'Garden';
